text:
I took the bowl to be roughly 22 cm across, which makes it a medium salad bowl. It holds spinach leaves, cucumber slices and chunks of cooked chicken. I could not see any dressing.

- **Spinach:** The leaves cover most of the bowl, but they are a thin, loose layer. I estimated about 45 g.
- **Cucumber:** I counted about 11 half-slices, each around 6 g, which gives roughly 65 g.
- **Chicken:** The chunks are a moderate amount, and I estimated about 85 g.
- **Edamame or pea:** I could see one or two, which is only a few grams, so I estimated about 5 g.
